case_generation: Fixed per-route random streams derived from the nonce committed in VERIFICATION_PROTOCOL.json; truth is computed independently and is not passed to constructor APIs

purpose.contract: Finite nondeterministic safe reachability with emergency-recovery obligations; successor is observation-contingent active fault diagnosis
purpose.independent_truth: Exhaustive action/outcome recursion on small finite games, independent of constructor's compiled layers
purpose.limits: Computational finite worlds only. No real autonomous-system safety or new-algorithm superiority follows.

interface.contract: Two-material monochromatic X-ray attenuation under common sample/reference multiplicative gain and separately observed dark offset; successor is tomographic reconstruction
interface.independent_truth: Beer-Lambert forward counts and independently assembled linear inversion/bounds; known projection geometry
case_families: common gain and dark drift cancellation
coherent sample/reference gain mismatch may be undetectable
interface.limits: Synthetic observations under a supplied attenuation model are not physical calibration or unknown-law discovery. Undetectable coherent model mismatch must be disclosed rather than declared detected.

complementarity.contract: Finite heat-pump and thermal-storage dispatch delivering specified heat under electrical/source/storage limits; successor is brine-recovery duty
complementarity.independent_truth: Direct residual reconstruction, analytic no-source/no-capacity limits, independent mass/salt/heat balances
complementarity.limits: An LP-feasible authored plant is not an installed production system or qualified physical process.

arrangement.contract: Clohessy-Wiltshire linearized maneuver mapping plus finite voluntary compensated maneuver choice; successor is two-impulse stand-off inspection
arrangement.independent_truth: Independent integration of the CW differential equations, terminal-state checks, and numerical Gaussian keep-out integration where compatible
arrangement.limits: Linearized finite examples are not flight safety, legal authority, truthful private information, real demand or an executed orbital service.

foundry.contract: Planar multilayer optical response and uncertainty-qualified design; successor changes antireflection to wavelength-selective routing
foundry.independent_truth: Analytic Fresnel and single-layer Airy formulas, energy conservation and reciprocal lossless special cases
foundry.limits: A computed coating/filter is not fabricated, optically measured, patentable or a complete photon/thermal-recycling system.

execution_rule: Adapt import names and data shapes to the final frozen public APIs without changing these case purposes. Record interface adaptation explicitly; any changed scientific criterion requires prospective amendment and no laundering of earlier failure.
claim_rule: Report output correctness, K2 distinction, causal advantage, Blue Sky residual, external validity and economic evidence separately. A competent conventional tie remains a tie.
